title: The zero-point field carries cosmic consciousness

statements.text: Stochastic electrodynamics treats the all-pervasive electromagnetic zero-point field as the source of the quantum behavior of matter. Shani and Keppler posit that this field also carries consciousness: all shades of phenomenal awareness are inherent in its frequency spectrum, so from outside it is a pool of activity and from inside a formless sea of consciousness. Later they call it a dual-aspect ubiquitous field of consciousness.

sources.quote: the ZPF is perfectly suited for playing the dual role as the carrier of both primordial energy and consciousness
formless sea of consciousness or unstructured ocean of awareness
the universe is imbued with a ubiquitous field of consciousness (UFC)
